title: centaurium triphyllum
intro: Centaurium triphyllum, commonly known as mountain long-coral or mountain coralroot, is a perennial plant in the gentian family, Gentianaceae. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe, particularly in the alpine meadows of the Alps. The health benefits of Centaurium triphyllum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful for treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including gentiopicroside, gentiogenin, and amarogentin, which have been shown to exhibit sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects.
